# Question
Should Kesari Foods launch a 200 g trial jar of mango pickle this Diwali, or keep only the 500 g jar?
# Options
- Launch the 200 g trial jar at 149 rupees alongside the 500 g jar
- Keep only the 500 g jar at 299 rupees
# What success looks like
More first-time buyers by 31 December without losing margin on the 500 g jar.
# Facts
- The 500 g jar sells for 299 rupees with a 38% margin (source: the brief).
- 62% of reviews mention trying the brand for the first time (source: the owner's review export, read 20 Oct 2026).
- A 200 g jar costs 61 rupees to make and pack (source: the brief; supplier quote).
# Constraints
Budget for new labels: 25,000 rupees. Launch must be live by 1 November.
